Scenario_A_RentTo750.Label: Rent increases to $2,000/mo if landlord passes through CAM
Scenario_A_RentTo750.BreakEvenCalculation: Fixed costs $8,285 + $150 increase = $8,435. At $350/retainer, $8,435/$350 = 24.1 -> need ~24 client equivalents.

Scenario_B_RentTo850.Label: Worst case: rent to $2,300/mo (unlikely per Ponce Office Suites lease)
Scenario_B_RentTo850.Impact: Still manageable. Would dip into reserves Dec-Jan but recover in spring.

BreakEvenAnalysis.KeyInsight: Break-even is ~24-25 retainer clients at current cost structure. At 18 retainers + flat-fee work we have headroom. Main concern is seasonal Dec dip.
